name: Cheech & Chong - 1g Cart - Dark Sky (I)
description:
Deep, smooth, and built to unwind. The Cheech & Chong Dark Sky cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Dark Sky brings a rich, after-hours profile: dark berry and stone fruit sweetness up front, layered with earthy depth and a smooth, subtly gassy finish. Blended with an indica terpene profile for a relaxed, mellow feel — the kind of easy calm that pairs best with late nights and slow evenings.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Dark Sky flavor — dark berry and stone fruit with earthy, gassy depth
Indica terpene blend — relaxing and mellow, ideal for evenings
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Rich flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Cheech & Chong Dark Sky is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
